note: Mechanical transcription of the same export's animations. Every curve is a raw `curve` array — absolute (time, value) control points copied verbatim — because an editor export carries a different bezier per key per channel and no named easing can say that. Each animation's `duration` is its own largest key time, because skeleton JSON has no duration field and that is the number a runtime loads. COMPLETE: every timeline the export carries is stated here, including the ik, transform and deform groups. Two restatements the format's own defaults make lossless: (1) a field the export omits on some keys of a constraint timeline is written out loud on every key of it, because the parser reads each key with its own default rather than holding the previous key's value — the effective values are identical and the field set is uniform, which is what rigc requires; (2) `hoverboard`'s `hoverboard-board` deform run starts at export offset 1, mid-pair, because that run's leading x is exactly 0 — it is restated as offset 0 with that 0 written, which the zero-filled deform array makes the same geometry.
